reference_sql:
SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, ph.list_price_eur
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = ol.product_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) <= ph.valid_to)
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-06'
alternatives: SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, ph.list_price_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = ol.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-06' BETWEEN ph.valid_from AND COALESCE(ph.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-07'

WITH day_prices AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-06' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-06')) SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, d.list_price_eur FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN day_prices d ON d.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-06'

other_way.sql: WITH day_prices AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-06' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-06')) SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, d.list_price_eur FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN day_prices d ON d.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-06'

solver.query:
SELECT l.order_line_id, p.product_name, h.list_price_eur
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = l.product_id
  AND h.valid_from <= CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)
  AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to >= CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE))
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
